note: GraphQL Compose is a no-code GraphQL schema builder. Its state is a per-server config object graphql_compose.settings.<server_id> (default graphql_compose.settings.graphql_compose_server) with keys entity_config.<type>.<bundle>.{enabled,query_load_enabled,type_sdl,description}, field_config.<type>.<bundle>.<field>.{enabled,required,name_sdl}, and global settings.* flags (exclude_unpublished, expose_entity_ids, simple_queries, simple_unions, site_*, ...). It builds the schema via three custom plugin managers (EntityType, FieldType, SchemaType). All medium/hard cases are grounded in that real config object (safe to toggle and restore; install baseline is entity_config:{} / expose_entity_ids:false). Evals avoid live GraphQL queries per campaign guidance; scripts avoid 'drush cr' because this shared site cannot rebuild the container.

evals.prompt: In GraphQL Compose (Drupal), there is no per-module settings page. Which configuration object holds the schema settings for a server, and what config key exposes the Article node type as a GraphQL type?
evals.expected_output: The config object is graphql_compose.settings.<server_id> (default graphql_compose.settings.graphql_compose_server). Set entity_config.node.article.enabled = true to expose the Article bundle (and query_load_enabled = true to add a load-by-UUID query).

evals.prompt: How does GraphQL Compose turn Drupal's data model into a GraphQL schema? Name the three kinds of GraphQL Compose plugins it uses.
evals.expected_output: Three custom plugin types: EntityType plugins (Plugin/GraphQLCompose/EntityType) map Drupal entity types to GraphQL object types; FieldType plugins (Plugin/GraphQLCompose/FieldType) map Drupal field types to GraphQL fields; SchemaType plugins (Plugin/GraphQLCompose/SchemaType) declare reusable GraphQL types. Resolution uses the base graphql module's DataProducer and SchemaExtension plugins.

evals.prompt: Name some of the global schema toggles under the 'settings' key of a GraphQL Compose server config, and say what one of them does.
evals.expected_output: settings.* includes exclude_unpublished (hide unpublished entities), expose_entity_ids (expose internal IDs alongside UUIDs), simple_queries / simple_unions, field_required_override, and site_name/site_slogan/site_mail/site_front/site_403/site_404, plus schema_description/schema_version and inflector_* options.

evals.prompt: On this site, one node bundle has been exposed in GraphQL Compose. Inspect the graphql_compose.settings.graphql_compose_server config and state which node bundle is enabled and whether it also has a single load-by-UUID query enabled.
evals.expected_output: node.article is enabled: entity_config.node.article.enabled = true and query_load_enabled = true.

evals.prompt: Inspect the live GraphQL Compose server settings and report the current value of the 'expose_entity_ids' toggle (whether internal entity IDs are exposed in the schema).
evals.expected_output: settings.expose_entity_ids is true on the graphql_compose.settings.graphql_compose_server config (internal IDs are exposed).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use GraphQL Compose to expose the Article (node) content type in the GraphQL schema for the default server (graphql_compose_server). Apply the change to the live configuration.

On this Drupal site, configure the GraphQL Compose server (graphql_compose_server) so that internal entity IDs are exposed in the GraphQL schema (in addition to UUIDs). Apply the change to the live configuration.
